Item #3
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-e be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive full reading of ordinances and that they be read in title only.
b.
Approval of Warrants/Payroll Register
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the Warrants/Payroll Register be approved and filed.
Item #7b
c.
Budget Modification for Citywide Computer Replacement
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the City Council approves budget modifications as detailed under the fiscal impact section of the staff report to implement the Citywide Computer Replacement Program.

Presented by Carla Dillon, P.E., Public Works Director
Item #8
9.
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZATION TO EXECUTE AN AGREEMENT FOR A DOWNTOWN LOMITA BRANDING PLAN WITH WARE MALCOMB
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community & Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with Ware Malcomb to prepare a branding plan for the City’s Downtown for an amount up to $12,000; and to permit City Manager authorization of a 15% contingency.
Item #9
10.
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION PERTAINING TO VARIOUS ACTIONS RELATIVE TO CITYWIDE REORGANIZATION
Presented by Gary Sugano, Assistant City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION:
1)
Adopt a resolution implementing a Citywide Reorganization establishing a revised list of full-time positions and;
2)
Approving the attached job descriptions and;
3)
Approving a revised comp plan for Non-Represented Employees (updating job titles only) RES 2019 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 81-56, A RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING AUTHORIZED POSITIONS AND COMPENSATION PLAN FOR EMPLOYEES FOR FISCAL YEAR COMMENCING JULY 1, 2018 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2019
Lomita City Council Meeting Agenda0May 7, 2019

CONSIDERATION TO RE-APPOINT GREGG MCCLAIN AS SBWIB BOARD REP FOR LOMITA
Presented by Ryan Smoot, City Manager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council re-appoint Mr. Gregg MCClain to serve an additional 4-year term on the South Bay Workforce Investment Board (SBWIB) and to direct staff to send a letter of reappointment to the Board.

12.

Presented by Carla Dillon, P.E., Public Works Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Consider adoption of a Resolution of Intent to levy annual assessments for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2019-2020.

TO LEVY AND COLLECT ASSESSMENTS WITHIN THE LOMITA LANDSCAPE MAINTENANCE DISTRICT NO. 1 FOR THE FISCAL YEAR COMMENCING JULY 1, 2019, AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2020, AND SETTING A PUBLIC HEARING DATE OF JUNE 4, 2019

ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 21, 2019, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: May 2, 2019
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
